title: Claude Code runner options
description: The run/start options the Claude Code runner takes, each optional. They fill the runner contract's runnerOptions extension point. Nothing here names a program to run.

model.description: The model Claude Code uses, passed as --model. Absent: Claude Code's own default. It can't start with '-', so Claude Code can't read it as a flag.

maxBudgetUsd.description: The most a run may spend, in US dollars, passed as --max-budget-usd. Absent: the runner's default, USD 5.

permissionMode.description: Claude Code's permission mode, passed as --permission-mode: dontAsk or plan, which both deny whatever no rule allows. Absent: dontAsk. What Claude Code may change comes from the actor's effects, so the modes that approve edits without a rule (acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions, manual) are refused.

allowedTools.description: Permission rules that allow a tool, such as Read or Bash(git status), written to a settings file as permissions.allow. A rule for an editing tool (Edit, Write, NotebookEdit, MultiEdit) or for troupe's own tools (mcp__troupe) is refused: what Claude Code may change comes from the actor's effects.

disallowedTools.description: Permission rules that deny a tool, written to a settings file as permissions.deny.

settingSources.description: The Claude Code setting sources to load. Absent: none, so the actor runs no settings, hooks or MCP servers of the person's or the workspace's.

items.description: One permission rule, in Claude Code's syntax.
